The structure of Li12Ti8O24 (reduced formula Li3Ti2O6) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and 44 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies octahedral environments throughout: Li centers coordinate six O neighbors, Ti centers also six O neighbors, and O centers six neighbors (three Li, three Ti), with all neighbor distances at 2.0688 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 44 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include edge-sharing between Li octahedra and between O octahedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing between Li and Ti octahedra.
